title: Full blk.0 Q8_0 up-skip correctness gate with CPU-compatible CUDA arithmetic

candidate.name: GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_CPU_COMPAT=1 full blk.0 ffn_up_exps pre-fallback skip
candidate.why_this_step: Validate that CPU-compatible arithmetic is token-stable over all eligible layer-0 up calls before expanding to more layers or benchmarking.
candidate.expected_ram_pressure: Same 16GB/no-swap cgroup as prior verifier; no new model residency.
candidate.expected_ttft_impact: Not evaluated in this correctness-only run.

correctness_gate.check: Run llama-results --check with GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_CPU_COMPAT=1, GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_SKIP_NAME_FILTER=blk.0.ffn_up_exps.weight, GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_SKIP_MAX_CALLS=0, and --top1-fail-on-mismatch.
correctness_gate.pass_condition: llama-results exits 0, same_top1 == n_tokens, first_mismatch_pos == -1, max_abs == 0, mean_abs == 0.
correctness_gate.failure_rule: If full blk.0 fails, do not expand scope; inspect the first failing record under CPU-compatible arithmetic.

promotion_rule: This correctness run cannot be promoted as SOTA. A later strict cold France benchmark is required for any token-rate claim.
